label: History
value: Magic in Oz is primarily represented by the Wizard of Oz.
unit: Within the first three Oz books, generic sorcerers and practitioners of magic are referenced as part of the magical landscape of the Land of Oz. However, no specific, prominent character named simply "Sorcerer" plays a individual named role in these early volumes. Magic in Oz is primarily represented by figures such as the Wizard of Oz, Glinda the Good Witch, and the Wicked Witches.

value: Loyal and protective of friends

label: History
value: Glinda the Good Witch pursued Mombi.
unit: Mombi originally acquired the baby Princess Ozma from the Wizard of Oz and transformed the infant into a boy named Tip to hide her true identity. She raised Tip as a ward and servant on her farm in the Gillikin Country, treating him harshly. Using the Powder of Life obtained from Dr. Nikidik, she brought Jack Pumpkinhead to life after Tip constructed him as a prank. When Mombi threatened to turn Tip into a marble statue, Tip fled with Jack, prompting Mombi to ally herself with General Jinjur's revolting army of girls. Mombi used her shapeshifting abilities to aid Jinjur in maintaining control over Emerald City against the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman. Glinda the Good Witch eventually intervened, pursuing Mombi and forcing her to surrender. Under Glinda's threat of severe punishment, Mombi confessed her secret spell and restored Tip to her true form as Princess Ozma, losing her own magical powers in the process.

label: History
value: Glinda discovers that Tip is actually Princess Ozma.
unit: Tip grows up in the northern country of the Gillikins under the harsh care of the witch Mombi. To scare Mombi, he constructs a man made of wood with a pumpkin head, named Jack Pumpkinhead. Mombi brings Jack to life using the Powder of Life, and Tip steals the magical powder to escape with Jack. Along their travels to the Emerald City, Tip brings a wooden Sawhorse to life to serve as a steed. Upon arriving, they find the city overthrown by General Jinjur and her Army of Revolt. Tip allies with the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and later the Woggle-Bug and the Gump to escape Jinjur and seek the aid of Glinda the Good. Glinda discovers that Tip is actually Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of Oz, who was enchanted by Mombi as a baby. Tip reluctantly agrees to the transformation, is restored to her original form as Princess Ozma, and takes her rightful place on the throne of Oz.

label: History
value: The Scarecrow saved his companions from the deadly poppy field.
unit: The Scarecrow was made by a Munchkin farmer to guard a cornfield, where Dorothy Gale found him perched on a pole. Joining Dorothy on her journey down the Yellow Brick Road to ask the Wizard of Oz for brains, he proved his quick thinking repeatedly by saving his companions from various perils, including the Kalidahs and the deadly poppy field. Upon reaching the Emerald City, the Wizard sent the group to defeat the Wicked Witch of the West, during which the Scarecrow was dismantled by Winged Monkeys before being reassembled by his friends after the Witch's destruction. When the Wizard returned to the Emerald City, he gave the Scarecrow a pseudo-brain made of bran, pins, and needles, appointing him as the new ruler of the Emerald City. He governed the city until General Jinjur and her Army of Revolt overthrew him using knitting needles. Escaping with the aid of Tip and Jack Pumpkinhead, the Scarecrow traveled to the Winkie Country to seek help from the Tin Woodman and Glinda, ultimately reclaiming the Emerald City before stepping down to allow Princess Ozma her rightful throne.

label: Appearance
value: She has inherent nobility.
unit: Ozma is a remarkably beautiful young girl with dark, flowing hair adorned with a royal tiara. She possesses a graceful demeanor, wearing elegant gowns suitable for the ruler of a fairyland. Her gentle expression reflects her youthful purity and inherent nobility.

label: History
value: The velvet heart filled with sawdust satisfied the Tin Woodman's desire.
unit: After rusting stiff in a Munchkin forest, the Tin Woodman was rescued by Dorothy Gale and the Scarecrow, who oiled his joints. He joined Dorothy's journey to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard of Oz for a heart. Along the way, he helped the group overcome numerous perils using his axe and strength. When sent by the Wizard to defeat the Wicked Witch of the West, he was dropped onto sharp rocks by the Winged Monkeys and battered, but he was later repaired by the Winkies. After the Wicked Witch was destroyed, the Winkies invited him to be their ruler. Upon returning to the Emerald City, the Wizard gave him a velvet heart filled with sawdust, which satisfied his desire. Later, he accompanied Dorothy to the South to see Glinda and took up his throne as Emperor of the Winkies. In subsequent events, he came to the aid of Tip and the Scarecrow when Jinjur rebelled, assisting in defeating General Jinjur's army and restoring Princess Ozma to the throne of Oz.

label: Appearance
value: The Saw-Horse is constructed from a wooden log body.
unit: The Saw-Horse is constructed from a wooden log body held up by four rough-hewn wooden legs. His head is a branch attached to the body, with a carved notch for a mouth and a small knot serving as an ear. He has no real eyes, ears, or internal organs, but he later receives gold-headed tacks driven into the bottoms of his legs by the Tin Woodman to keep his feet from wearing away.

label: Abilities
value: Controls a pack of giant wolves

label: History
value: Langwidere assumed the throne of Ev
unit: Langwidere assumed the throne of Ev following the death of her uncle, King Evoldo, who had enslaved his own wife and ten children to the Nome King before taking his own life. Indifferent to the fate of her royal cousins, Langwidere chose to live in luxury in her palace, spending her time swapping her thirty heads. When Dorothy Gale arrived in Ev accompanied by Tik-Tok and Billina, Langwidere met them but refused to help rescue the royal family of Ev. Coveting Dorothy's head for her collection, she demanded Dorothy trade heads with her and locked Dorothy in a tower when she refused. After Princess Ozma arrived with the army of Oz to rescue the royal family of Ev, Langwidere was intimidated by Ozma's authority and agreed to release Dorothy. She permitted Ozma and her party to proceed to the Nome King's underground kingdom, content to remain behind in her palace.

label: History
value: A cyclone swept Dorothy's house away with her and Toto inside
unit: Dorothy lived a quiet life on a Kansas farm with Aunt Em and Uncle Henry until a cyclone swept her house away with her and her dog Toto inside. The house landed in the Munchkin Country of Oz, accidentally crushing the Wicked Witch of the East. Dorothy was given the witch's Silver Shoes and instructed by the Good Witch of the North to follow the yellow brick road to the Emerald City so the Wizard of Oz could help her return home. Along the way, she befriended the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion. The Wizard agreed to grant her request if she defeated the Wicked Witch of the West, which Dorothy accomplished by melting the witch with a bucket of water. After revealing the Wizard as a humbug and missing her chance to leave in his hot air balloon, Dorothy traveled to the South to consult Glinda the Good Witch. Glinda revealed that the Silver Shoes could carry her anywhere, and Dorothy used them to return safely to Kansas, losing the shoes in the Deadly Desert along the way.

value: Pastoria was remembered as a lawful ruler of the Land of Oz before his overthrow.
unit: Pastoria was remembered as a rightful and lawful ruler of the Land of Oz before his overthrow. His reign was looked back upon with respect by those loyal to the traditional royal line of the Emerald City.

label: History
value: Santa Claus’s existence is recognized within the world.
unit: Santa Claus is referenced in the Oz series as a well-known benevolent figure of legend and magic. Though he does not directly feature in the main adventures of the first three volumes, his existence and magical nature are recognized within the world as the ultimate bringer of joy to children.

label: Personality
value: Tiktok acts with bravery consistently.
unit: Tiktok is entirely obedient, polite, and devoted to his companions. Because he is a mechanical creation, he lacks genuine human emotion and acts solely according to his programming and logic. He openly acknowledges that he cannot feel love or fear, yet he consistently acts with bravery, dutiful loyalty, and courteous consideration for others.

label: History
value: Tip journeyed across Oz alongside the Sawhorse.
unit: As an infant, Princess Ozma was carried away by the Wizard of Oz and entrusted to the wicked old woman Mombi, who enchanted the child into a boy named Tip to prevent her from claiming the throne. Tip grew up believing he was an orphan living with Mombi, eventually running away with a wooden figure he created named Jack Pumpkinhead. Alongside Jack, the Sawhorse, the Scarecrow, and the Tin Woodman, Tip journeyed across Oz and helped reclaim the Emerald City from General Jinjur's Army of Revolt. Seeking the aid of Glinda the Good, the companions discovered that Tip was actually Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of Oz. Glinda forced Mombi to undo the enchantment, restoring Ozma to her true female form and her rightful heritage. Ozma assumed the throne of the Emerald City, restoring peace and establishing her benevolent reign over the land.

label: Personality
value: The Wizard acts out of fear.
unit: The Wizard is a self-proclaimed humbug and charlatan, though he possesses a kind heart and a conscience. He is resourcefully clever and adept at deception, but he acts out of fear and a desire for self-preservation rather than malice. He feels genuine regret for deceiving his people and goes out of his way to fulfill his promises to Dorothy and her companions using clever tricks.

label: Appearance
value: Langwidere is slim.
unit: Langwidere is a slim and beautiful princess who wears luxurious robes. She possesses thirty different exchangeable heads, each with a distinct face and hairstyle, stored in velvet-lined cabinets in her private boudoir. She frequently changes her head to match her mood or outfit, keeping Head Number 17 as her primary or original head.

label: Personality
value: Uncle Henry is a stern man.
unit: Uncle Henry is a stern, quiet, and hardworking man who rarely speaks or shows emotion. The hardships of farm life have taken a toll on his spirit, making him solemn and grave. Despite his austere demeanor, he cares deeply for his family and works tirelessly to provide for them.

label: History
value: Tiktok remained trapped
unit: Tiktok was created in the kingdom of Ev by the inventors Smith and Tinker, who sold him to the King of Ev. After the royal family of Ev was sold to the Nome King, Tiktok was locked away in a rocky cave with instructions on his back explaining how to wind his clockwork mechanisms. He remained trapped and motionless until Dorothy Gale and Billina discovered him. Dorothy wound his clockwork, bringing him back to life, and he immediately pledged his service to her. Tiktok defended Dorothy from the Wheeler population and helped her meet Princess Langwidere. He accompanied Princess Ozma's expedition to the underground kingdom of the Nome King to rescue the royal family of Ev. During their travels, Tiktok ran down several times at critical moments, requiring his friends to re-wind his thought, speech, or motion mechanisms. He bravely engaged in the trials against the Nome King and assisted in the party's ultimate victory before journeying to the Emerald City of Oz.
